title: La última luz
logline: En un umbral nevado, una mujer espera a alguien que no volverá; un farolero viene a apagar la lámpara y acaba dejando la suya.

beats.line: La luz del umbral seguía encendida.
beats.speaker: narrator
beats.cameraMotive: start on the one light that has been kept alive; the question is who is waiting for it
beats.transitionMotive: open on the object that carries the waiting, not on an establishing shot
beats.note: hook: the lit threshold and the snow, no actor; the light is the promise that has not gone out

beats.line: La vieja esperaba a alguien que no volvía.
beats.speaker: narrator
beats.cameraMotive: bring the woman and the arriving lamplighter into one frame so the wait becomes a relationship
beats.transitionMotive: the light becomes a person; the cut moves from the object to the waiting
beats.note: setup: the old woman at the door, the young lamplighter entering with his lantern

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.cameraMotive: follow the lamplighter's reach toward the wall lamp; the conflict is the hand that wants to end the wait
beats.transitionMotive: the arrival turns into an action; the camera moves with the decision
beats.note: escalation: he reaches for the lamp; the woman turns to stop him

beats.speaker: none
beats.cameraMotive: hold the woman's face as the light she has kept becomes a decision about letting go
beats.transitionMotive: hard cut to the person who carries the cost of the light
beats.note: reaction: wordless close-up; the hand at the lamp is the cause, the face is the consequence

actors.continuityMotive: cut into a close-up of the same woman at the same threshold; no stage move

beats.line: Él dejó su propia luz en la nieve.
beats.speaker: narrator
beats.cameraMotive: follow the lamplighter out and reveal the lantern he leaves behind, without making the object a new exposition
beats.transitionMotive: the decision produces a visible trace in the snow
beats.note: reveal: he walks away; the set state shows his lantern left in the snow

beats.line: Y se fue sin decir nada.
beats.speaker: narrator
beats.cameraMotive: release from the woman and the left lantern; the light remains as the only answer
beats.transitionMotive: settle on the trace and the waiting; no new information after this
beats.note: close: the woman stays, the young man is gone, and the second lantern is still lit in the snow
